screens.title: Screen map
screens.job: Every Scholē screen, part and component number in one list, with the Mobbin screens each is built after.

screens.title: Home
screens.job: Pick up the lesson you were on, see your week of study, and start a course when you have none.

parts.name: Continue learning
parts.job: The course you were on, its progress and Resume, which opens the next lesson.

parts.name: Getting started
parts.job: Three steps for a newcomer: choose what to understand, read a first lesson, check it.

parts.name: Your week
parts.job: The days you studied this week. Habits are built by doing (Ethics II.1).

parts.name: Recommended for you
parts.job: Courses from the subjects you picked, each with why.

parts.name: Nature, habits, reason
parts.job: Scholē's three parts, each leading to where it is worked on.

screens.title: Get started
screens.job: Three questions, one per screen: what you want to understand, how long a day, where to begin.

parts.name: Subjects you want to understand
parts.job: Tap tiles for the nine subjects, any number.

parts.name: Time a day
parts.job: Ten, twenty or forty minutes.

parts.name: Where to begin
parts.job: The first course of the first subject picked, with Start course.

screens.title: Courses
screens.job: Every course, one per work of Aristotle, filtered by subject and level.

parts.name: Subject tabs
parts.job: All, then the nine subjects.

parts.name: Level filter
parts.job: Start here, Intermediate, Advanced.

parts.name: Course grid
parts.job: Course cards; one in progress shows how far you are.

parts.name: Lecture courses
parts.job: The Yale and MIT lecture courses Scholē already plays, one link away.

screens.title: Subjects
screens.job: The nine subjects in Aristotle's own division: the instrument, knowing, doing and making.

parts.name: Division
parts.job: One group per division, with Aristotle's reason for it.

parts.name: Subject cards
parts.job: Name in English and Greek, what it studies, works and hours.

screens.title: Subject
screens.job: One subject's works as a numbered path in reading order, with examination at the end.

parts.name: Numbered path
parts.job: Each work as a step, with level and hours.

parts.name: Examination at the end
parts.job: Put yourself under examination by people on the subject.

screens.title: Course
screens.job: What the work asks, its books as units with their lessons, and Start or Continue.

parts.name: Course head
parts.job: Title, Greek and Latin names, facts line, Start course or Continue, Save.

parts.name: About this course
parts.job: What the work asks, the caveat when there is one, and the translation read.

parts.name: Units
parts.job: One unit per book, each with its lessons and progress.

parts.name: Progress card
parts.job: How far you are, time left, and Continue learning.

parts.name: Examination card
parts.job: Examiners are people: put yourself under examination on this work.

screens.title: Lesson
screens.job: Read one idea: the passage in Aristotle's words, what it says, its terms, then check it.

parts.name: Passage
parts.job: The text, verbatim, with its Bekker reference and translator.

parts.name: What it says
parts.job: The lesson in plain sentences.

parts.name: Terms
parts.job: Its Greek terms, each opening the glossary.

parts.name: Unit contents
parts.job: The unit's lessons beside the reading, with Start check.

parts.name: Take it to your journal
parts.job: A question that opens a new journal entry with it.

parts.name: Previous and next
parts.job: The lessons either side, across units.

screens.title: Lesson check
screens.job: Two or three tap-choice questions, one at a time, each answered with why. No score.

parts.name: Progress bar
parts.job: How many questions are left; the cross goes back to the lesson.

parts.name: Question
parts.job: The question and its choices, numbered for the keyboard.

parts.name: Answer bar
parts.job: Right, or not quite, with why, the passage again, and Continue.

screens.title: Lesson complete
screens.job: What you now know, your week, the journal question, and the next lesson.

parts.name: What you now know
parts.job: The lesson's terms and its one idea.

parts.name: Next lesson
parts.job: Continue goes straight to it; at a unit's end, the course page.

parts.name: Share lesson
parts.job: Copy the lesson's link for a friend.

screens.title: Your growth
screens.job: Nature, habits and reason: what you are drawn to, how steadily you study, and how far you know each subject.

parts.name: Reason graph
parts.job: One axis per subject: the share of its lessons you have read and checked.

parts.name: Habits
parts.job: Days studied in the last four weeks.

parts.name: Nature
parts.job: The subjects you said you want to understand, and Change.

screens.title: Saved
screens.job: Lessons and courses you saved to come back to.

screens.title: Search
screens.job: Find a course, a lesson or a term by any word in it.

screens.title: Glossary
screens.job: Every Greek term the courses teach, with where each is taught.

screens.title: Put yourself under examination
screens.job: Say what you will answer for on a course; people examine you in person. No grade.

screens.title: Your library
screens.job: Books, highlights, notes, schedule and lists you keep (unchanged in this rework).

screens.title: Browse
screens.job: Books, lectures, podcasts and playlists from every medium (unchanged in this rework).
